narr: Monsoon moisture advecting around the periphery of the big ridge causing excessive heat fueled scattered thunderstorms. Several storms produced high winds and/or flooding.
ev: Heavy rain triggered a landslide along Whitney Portal Road, blocking both lanes with large boulders.
Water and debris were all over Highway 127 at Dumont Dunes Rd.
Highway 62 was flooded in multiple places from Mesquite Springs Rd to Encelia Dr.
Three roads were closed due to flooding.
Kelbaker Rd was closed from I-40 to Kelso Depot due to flash flooding and debris flow. The road reopened on 7/25.
The intersection of Highway 62 and Godwin Rd was flooded.
Highway 168 was flooded with water, rocks, and debris near Deep Springs Ranch Rd. A plow had to clear the road.
